steps.note: the API built this case's state
Use an RFQ pricing stage rather than the default auction stage.
Configure the RFQ stage before selecting its template and items.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Create one line item with the requested quantity of 10 units.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Commit a bidding schedule before publishing.
Invite exactly two vendors so the event can receive two competing bids.
Submit the first vendor bid, representing the higher bid.
Confirm the first vendor bid was accepted.
Submit the second vendor bid, representing the L1 vendor.
Confirm the second vendor bid was accepted.
Close bidding so awarding is available.
Open the comparison grid to inspect both vendor bids before awarding.
Assert that both bidding vendors appear as real vendor columns.
Assert that the lower bid ranks ahead of the higher bid.
Allocate the entire line to the L1 vendor and submit the award proposal.
Confirm the award proposal was created and submitted.
